text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Once it begins, it's over in a flash. In 
less than two minutes, our debut 
performance will come to an end.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Now, how was today's magic trick?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this year's newcomers are truly 
magnificent... Way to go! Satono Crown!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, Satono might just claim 
their first GⅠ victory...! I'm so looking 
forward to your next race――!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Satono Crown takes a bow, an even 
fiercer round of applause and cheers 
erupts from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And as if joining that surge, my own 
hands began to move as well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Oh! Are you satisfied as well, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Ah... That was a good run.
Yeah... that was a great run.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Right? Hard work never betrays us, and I 
won't betray your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how many people out there would 
actually take those words at face value.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet Satono Crown had the power to make 
them believe it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Phew... Trainer. About our next goal...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"How about the Tokyo Sports Hai Junior 
Stakes?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Tokyo Sports Hai Junior Stakes, 
commonly known as the Tospo Hai, is a GIII 
1800m race in Tokyo. It's a proving ground 
for girls aiming for Junior Class GIs."
choice_data_list:
So you're building a solid foundation for 
entering GⅠ races there, right?

So you're building a solid foundation for 
entering GⅠ races there, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes. Will you give me permission to race?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If the fruits of our effort will lead to 
the success we aim to create.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —All I have to do is forge straight ahead.
choice_data_list:
I'll do everything I can to help you 
prepare.

I'll do everything I can to help you 
prepare!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
With that look on your face, I know I can 
count on you. Well then... I'm in your 
hands!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kura-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kura-chan! Kura-chan's Trainer! 
Congratulations on your debut!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Dia! Do-je ah! Did you come to see me?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yep♪ I made up my mind that I'd definitely 
go see Kura-chan's debut race!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And also...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kura-chan's Trainer. Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Having watched today's race... I have a 
request for you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kura-chan! The next training session is on 
dirt, okay?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Okaaay. Understood, Sub-Trainer Dia♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond's "request" was that she 
wanted to study training under me for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond hasn't hit her growth peak 
yet. Even if she wants to prepare for her 
debut, hard training could easily lead to 
an injury.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...'Then instead of your body, use your 
brain!' Apparently that's how they came up 
with this format."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Just wondering~, Sub-Trainer? Do you mind 
if I ask why you're having them run on 
dirt at this time of year, just to be 
sure?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Umm, that's...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. Why?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see. Makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Kura-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Even for Cla-chan, invisible fatigue must 
be lingering in her legs after the big 
race," so let's check her condition on 
dirt instead of turf!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Fufu... OK!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Keep up the great work mentoring the 
sub-trainer, all right, Trainer? ♪
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I look forward to working with you 
too, Dia.

Yeah, looking forward to working with you 
too, Dia.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I may be inexperienced, but please 
take good care of me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, with new companions joining their 
ranks, the days of training for their next 
goal, the Tokyo Sports Hai, began!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(...Now then, Trainer. Here is another 
quiz for you.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Why do you think Dia wanted to become 
your sub-trainer?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Is it because you are the Trainer that 
fellow Satono, Satono Crown, placed her 
trust in?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Buzz! Incorrect.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(The answer is because you and I showed 
her a miracle at the Make Debut.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Because the instructions you gave brought 
out the absolute best in me.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Because this race was the fruit of all 
your hard work— studying races every day 
and crafting training menus for me.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Dia's heart must have been moved. 
Thinking, "Maybe it wouldn't hurt to learn 
under Kura-chan's Trainer.")

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(See? The effort you've put in is truly 
incredible.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(...I won't let you make such an 
unconfident face ever again, got it?)
